content: {"episode_id":"ep-05048","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, which was denied because required prior authorization was not obtained. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction. Given concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology contributing to these symptoms, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other significant rhythm disturbances. We request reconsideration based on this documented clinical justification."}
